about: Held-out call set (27 Nov 2026), written as new conversations AFTER the keyword rules and the classifier's training set, and never used to tune either. Indirect scams and hard negatives (genuine delivery OTPs, genuine bank and police calls, genuine family money requests). Team-written: an honest second check, not an independent benchmark. A call is flagged at score >= 0.5.

Your last bill was not updated in our system.
Your power will be disconnected at nine tonight unless you pay now on the number I send you.
